# TryMyDay

> TryMyDay connects people with experienced professionals for practical career guidance through real conversations.

TryMyDay is designed for students, graduates, career switchers, and anyone seeking clearer information about a career path. Users can discover professionals, start with a short free coffee chat, and book focused paid sessions where available.

## Important pages

- [Home](https://trymyday.co.za/): Overview of TryMyDay and how it works.
- [About](https://trymyday.co.za/about): Mission, audience, and approach to career guidance.
- [FAQs](https://trymyday.co.za/faq): Answers about coffee chats, bookings, rates, scheduling, and sessions.
- [Professionals](https://trymyday.co.za/professionals): Information for professionals who want to share their experience.
- [Contact](https://trymyday.co.za/contact): Official support and contact options.

## Key facts

- TryMyDay provides access to real professionals and practical career insight.
- A free coffee chat is a short video or voice conversation for initial questions.
- Professionals can set their own rates and availability for paid sessions.
- TryMyDay serves users in South Africa.

Official contact: hello@trymyday.co.za
